newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE - Mosenergo H1 Russia pretax 2.4 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Mosenergo H1 Russia pretax 2.4 trln rbls.

text.p: Russian Mosenergo utility pretax profit to Russian accounting standards on a cash basis rose to 2.44 trillion roubles in the first half of this year from 2.01 trillion last year, the company said on Friday.
NOTES -- All figures to Russian accounts on a cash basis except sales-supplied, which is to Russian accounts on an accruals basis.

Company historical data differs from 1996 first half results released last year. Mosenergo gave no basis for calculation last year but said pretax profit for the first half of 1996 was 2.56 trillion roubles, net profit 1.79 trillion and sales 6.87 trillion. No comment from the company was available.
Historical production figures presented in the statement on Friday matched previously released data.
Capital expenditures for first half of the year were 1.21 trillion roubles, 50 percent of the target for the year.
Russian definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
